question: What was the official mascot of the Khelo India Winter Games 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Snow leopard 'Sheen-e She' (Shan)**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **official mascot** of the **Khelo India Winter Games 2024** was the **Snow Leopard named 'Sheen-e She' (Shan).** 
• The name **'Sheen-e She'** translates to **'The Snow Leopard'** in the local Kashmiri language, symbolizing the rich biodiversity and the majestic wildlife of the Himalayan region. 
• The **snow leopard** was chosen to represent the games because it is an **iconic species of the Himalayan region**, known for its resilience and adaptability to the extreme winter conditions, aligning with the spirit of the winter games. 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games 2024** aimed to **promote winter sports** and encourage youth participation in sports activities in the Himalayan region and across India. 
• The event was hosted in **Gulmarg, Jammu & Kashmir**, a well-known destination for winter sports and tourism, further emphasizing the importance of preserving the region's ecology and promoting sustainable tourism. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **About Snow Leopards:** 
• Snow leopards are a **vulnerable species** as per the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List, with their population under constant threat due to habitat loss and poaching. 
• They are commonly found in the **mountain ranges** of Central and South Asia, including the **Himalayas**, and are often referred to as "ghosts of the mountains" due to their elusive nature. 
• The snow leopard serves as a **flagship species** for conservation efforts in the Himalayan region and symbolizes the importance of preserving biodiversity. 
• **About Khelo India Initiative:** 
• Launched in **2018**, the **Khelo India Programme** is an initiative by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to **revive the sports culture** in India at the grassroot level. 
• It aims to identify young talent from schools and universities and provide them with the necessary infrastructure and training to excel in sports. 
• The Khelo India Winter Games is a part of this initiative to **promote winter sports** and establish India as a global hub for such activities. 
• **Objectives of Khelo India Winter Games:** 
• To **promote adventure tourism** and winter sports in the Himalayan regions. 
• To encourage **youth participation** in winter sports and develop their competitive spirit. 
• To highlight the rich **cultural heritage** and natural beauty of regions like Jammu and Kashmir. 
• **Key Features of Khelo India Winter Games 2024:** 
• The event included **various disciplines** like skiing, snowboarding, ice skating, and ice hockey. 
• It witnessed the participation of athletes from **across India** and international competitors, promoting the global recognition of India’s winter sports capability. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Other Mascots in Indian Sports:** 
• **Bharati the Leopard** - Mascot for the **36th National Games 2022** held in Gujarat. 
• **Veera the Bull** - Mascot for the **Khelo India Youth Games 2020** held in Guwahati, Assam. 
• **Mauli** - Mascot for the **18th Asian Games 2018** held in Jakarta, Indonesia (not related to Indian events but often referenced in sports discussions). 
• **Significance of Mascots:** 
• Mascots serve as **symbols of identity** and bring cultural, environmental, or regional significance to sports events. 
• They engage the audience emotionally and help in **branding** and promoting the event.
